verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents that its CLI can "access server APIs", and its token grants define "roomCreate — Permission to create or delete rooms" and "roomAdmin — Permission to moderate a room". Together these imply server-side room deletion (ending a session) and moderation, but the pack never documents the actual API operations. missing for 10: documented endpoints for listing rooms/sessions, explicit mute-participant and remove-participant operations, explicit end-session/delete-room API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a server-side API lets me list sessions, mute or remove participants, and end a session without a client in the loop

citations.quote: server APIs, create tokens, generate test traffic, and scaffold and deploy agents.
roomCreate — Permission to create or delete rooms
roomAdmin — Permission to moderate a room
